Unimplemented continuous response family

continuousGaussian.Rd

An unused development placeholder. This constructor records a proposed family, but magComp() rejects it because no fitting method is implemented. Use fixedAreaStems or pointBasalArea for supported models.

Usage

continuousGaussian(link = c("log", "identity"),
                   composition = c("logratio", "gaussian_stick"))

Arguments

link

Proposed magnitude link.

composition

Proposed composition representation.

Value

A magCompFamily object that cannot be fitted.
